$comment: Audit gate allowlist — consumed by scripts/quality/audit-gate.mjs (pnpm quality:audit, CI job 'Audit Dependencies'). An advisory passes ONLY if it matches both `ghsa` and `package` here AND `expires` has not passed. Never add an entry while a patched version exists upstream — check `npm view <package> dist-tags.latest` first. Expired entries fail the build on purpose.
